engineeringSkip.reason: Femtotechnology — manipulating gluons and quarks to build stable nuclear-scale structures — has no basis in known physics; quarks are confined and cannot be assembled into materials, so this is speculation rather than an engineering pathway.

factCheck.reason: Quarks and gluons cannot be picked up and rearranged like atoms — colour confinement means they never exist on their own outside a proton or neutron, so no stable 'material' can be engineered from them at the 10^-15 m scale.
